Strategy: Scale the winning band harder: reward a full item for the twenty-eight to forty-two window and penalize half an item for slivers, testing whether bigger item-scaled magnitudes help more. It may help by matching rewards to item scale more aggressively, but may fail if the bonus overwhelms tight fits.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (item if r - item >= 28 and r - item <= 42 else 0) - (item / 2 if r - item >= 6 and r - item <= 20 else 0) for r in bins]
```
